mostWorthwhile.text: Fitting the channels was most worthwhile because the result explained how local electrical changes carry a message without one ion travelling the whole length.

leastWorthwhile.text: The initial development pairings were fairly direct from the introduction, so choosing them involved less figuring out than the later cell structures.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the insulation is made by separate cells wrapping around the nerve cell, with gaps between the wraps.

arbitrary.text: The neuregulin-1 pairing had a clear purpose from the picture, although I was following the named contact message rather than understanding how that protein works.

continue.text: I would choose to continue because seeing how the channels and separate insulating cells fit together made me curious about what nerve messages do next.
